swapDirect(address,address,uint256,uint2.details: Swaps tokens directly via the pair contract, bypassing the router.

params.amountIn: The exact amount of tokenIn to swap.
params.amountOutMin: The minimum acceptable amount of the output token.
params.pair: The address of the Uniswap V2 pair (pool).
params.to: The address to receive the output tokens.
params.tokenIn: The address of the token you are swapping.
